title: Activation gate on accessibility conformance
objective: Block activation of a user-facing surface until its ACR shows no open WCAG 2.2 Level A or AA failure without a signed exception, and every Forma component used has a conformance statement or Unbound test.
owner: Proposed: Accessibility Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Automated accessibility checks as blocking CI
objective: Run automated WCAG rule checks, reflow, text-scale, forced-colors and reduced-motion tests on every build and block on regressions.
owner: Proposed: Accessibility Lead (role not yet staffed)
residual_risks: Automated tools detect a minority of WCAG failures; manual and AT testing remain necessary.
notes: Forma runs a blocking ui-conformance job in Chromium only; Firefox and WebKit evidence is listed as remaining work (forma@c8f40b4c:docs/UNIVERSAL-UI-CONFORMANCE.md). Automated checks find only a subset of WCAG failures.

title: Manual and assistive-technology testing of essential journeys
objective: Test every essential journey with keyboard only, named screen reader and browser pairs, and moderated sessions with disabled participants before release and after material change.
owner: Proposed: Accessibility Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Accessibility defect SLAs
objective: Track accessibility defects with severity-based remediation targets and provide an equivalent alternative while a defect is open.
owner: Proposed: Accessibility Lead (role not yet staffed)

title: Accessible rendition at issuance
objective: Issue every document with an accessible HTML rendition generated from the same snapshot and validate any PDF against PDF/UA-1 before release.
implementing_systems: Folio print components (folio@56a18e1; tagged PDF not provided)

title: Design-system accessibility contracts
objective: Provide components whose semantics, focus visibility, contrast-gated color roles, forced-colors projection, reflow and target sizes are contractually specified and tested, so applications inherit them.
notes: Forma color contract gates status foregrounds at 4.5:1 and projects to system colors in forced-colors mode (forma@c8f40b4c:docs/COLOR.md). Pilot status; not a passed release gate.

title: Sponsor brand contrast compilation gate
objective: Fail compilation of any sponsor brand whose color pairs fall below contrast thresholds, naming the failing pair.
notes: Forma requirement BRAND-A11Y-001 states a compiled brand shall preserve the WCAG 2.2 AA target; CNV-EXP-001 AC-1 specifies the Unbound behavior.

title: Accessibility legal applicability review
objective: Have counsel determine applicable accessibility law by customer segment and reflect it in contracts and roadmap.
owner: Proposed: General Counsel (role not yet staffed)

title: Accessible assurance and support paths
objective: Provide identity-verification, authentication and support paths usable without sight, hearing, fine motor control or memorization, reaching the same assurance level as other paths.
implementing_systems: Unbound identity and contact assurance (not built)
owner: Proposed: Accessibility Lead (role not yet staffed)
